summary: Iter60 CheerPlanner Team Hub 'Text who owes' SMS nudge — frontend-only verification PASSED on mobile viewport 390x844 with applereview@cheerplanner.app / team_access=true. Created TEST_NUDGE_v60 tracker (expected $40/person, 1 roster personnel unpaid). Detail screen renders the blue 'Text who owes (1)' button with testID payment-nudge under the amber outstanding banner in the summary card, N=1 matches unpaid count. Tapping payment-nudge does NOT crash — no red screen, no LogBox modal, no window.pageerror, no console errors (only the harmless expected 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated' warning). Regression flows all green: payment-owe-banner reads '1 person owes · $40.00 outstanding', per-row 'owes $40.00' tag renders next to the unpaid member instead of 'Record'. Recording a full $40 Cash payment via payment-member-* modal updates summary to '1/1 paid · $40.00 collected' and — critically — both the payment-nudge button and payment-owe-banner disappear (both count=0) once everyone is paid in full, matching the spec that the nudge is only shown when someone owes. Test tracker cleaned up via DELETE /api/team/payments/{id} (verified empty list). Note on web-only fallback path: RN Web's Linking.canOpenURL('sms:...') always resolves true (RN Web default polyfill), so the 'Can't open Messages' Alert branch does not fire in the web preview — the sms: URL is opened silently via window.open which is a no-op in Chromium. No crash occurs, which satisfies the primary safety requirement. The alert-fallback code path (Alert.alert 'Can't open Messages' / 'No phone numbers') will only actually be reachable on native iOS/Android where canOpenURL properly checks the URL scheme. Spec explicitly acknowledges 'SMS-compose feature is NATIVE-ONLY — just verify the button + graceful fallback on web, do not expect Messages to open' so this is expected behavior. No deprecated Expo packages introduced by this change; no SafeAreaView issues. Feature is production-ready for native builds.
critical_code_review_comments: payment.tsx nudgeOwing() (lines 138-157) correctly early-returns with 'All caught up' alert when owing.length===0 (defensive — button also hidden when owingCount===0 so this path is unreachable from UI but good to have), and 'No phone numbers' alert when phones array is empty after dedup. sms: URL uses ',' separator for multiple recipients which iOS Messages accepts, and platform-specific '&'/'?' separator for the body param (& on iOS, ? on Android) matches standard sms: URI convention.

phoneFor() (line 136) correctly prefers m.phone for personnel (isPersonnel(role)) and m.parent_phone for athletes, with fallback to the other field — matches roster data model per spec (athletes use parent_phone, personnel use their own phone).
owingCount computation (line 159) uses owedFor(m)!==0 which includes both partial-payers (owed>0) and never-recorded members (owed===-1 when expected is null and !paid) — correct inclusive count.

payment-nudge button only rendered when owingCount>0 (line 218 guard) — matches spec requiring button hidden when everyone is paid in full. Verified live: after full payment, both banner and nudge disappear.

On RN Web, Linking.canOpenURL('sms:...') always returns true (RN Web polyfill). The try/catch fallback to Alert.alert 'Can't open Messages' therefore only actually fires on native. Not a bug given the NATIVE-ONLY spec note, but worth documenting.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (button render + count match + no-crash on tap + hide-when-paid + regression banner/owes-tags + record-payment flow + cleanup)
